method: SHA256 of full APK and every uncompressed ZIP entry, not CRC-only comparison
limits: Runtime processing cost is not measured by byte preservation.
APK signing-block bytes differ across signed versions; this audit independently verifies pinned full package hashes, not signatures.
Behavior of class deltas requires separate class projection/source audit.

independentDexClassReview.limitation: Class projection compares byte-exact disassembly including debug info and explicit static arrays; this is not an execution test.
